headline_stat.name: fraction of place cells with negative (precessing) circular-linear slope

justification.dataset: DANDI 000044 Achilles CA1 linear-track session is the canonical dataset for theta phase precession in place cells.
justification.handling: Real streamed NWB data with correct maze-epoch alignment, excitatory-unit and peak-rate filtering, speed/direction splitting, and phase-invariant LFP conversion.
justification.analysis: Kempter circular-linear regression with a shuffle null that correctly maximizes over the same slope grid, plus a binomial population test and circular statistics throughout.
justification.correctness: Every headline number (67/87 significant, 72/87 negative, p=4.3e-10, median -1.10 cyc/m, R 0.325 vs 0.236) reproduces exactly from the committed results file and is internally consistent.
justification.figures: Place-field tiling, theta extraction, and the pooled descending wedge clearly show the phenomenon with labeled units and sample sizes; two example panels have near-flat slopes but are honestly labeled and ranked by the correct R criterion.
justification.honesty: Claims are proportionate and all numbers are supported and reproduce, with examples honestly labeled and single-pass noise shown, but no specific limitation (single session, shallow-slope cases) is named.
